_about: Flora Annie Steel's (1847-1929) folk tales: Tales of the Punjab (1894, the stories she gathered in the Punjab, with R. C. Temple's notes; first issued as Wide-Awake Stories, 1884) and her retold English Fairy Tales (1918, ill. Arthur Rackham). Clean Gutenberg text; US public domain. Her novels are not taken.
